heroDesc: Empowering every citizen with deterministic welfare access. We combine natural multilingual dialogue with rigid, verifiable eligibility code to bridge government welfare directly to you.
journeySubtitle: Deterministic path from discovery to disbursement
step1Desc: Speak or type your current household circumstances. Discover central and state schemes mapped to your real needs.
step2Desc: Schemes broken down into plain audio & localized language summaries. Know your exact entitlements with zero confusion.
step3Desc: Rule trees test income, age, landholding, and caste conditions with 100% mathematical auditability.
step4Desc: Auto-generated checklist of verified documents needed (Aadhaar, Bank passbook, Khatiyan) with instant camera scanner.
step5Desc: Guided pre-filled submission to official government portals or nearest Common Service Center (CSC) kiosk.
step6Desc: Real-time DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer) tracking and proactive SMS/WhatsApp alerts for annual subsidy release dates.
archDesc: No personal records retained on hard disks. Built to exceed MeitY and DPDP Act 2023 guidelines.
stage1Desc: Speech converted into intent vectors using local Indian language models without biometric voiceprint retention.
stage2Desc: Static JSON rule trees evaluated in volatile memory. No generative hallucinations deciding citizen welfare rights.
stage3Desc: Documents exist purely in RAM during verification and are automatically zeroized upon session completion.
stage4Desc: HMAC-SHA256 signed eligibility certificates prove scheme entitlement for physical CSC or banking verification.
interactiveDesc: Test our voice-assisted discovery and instant rule evaluation in real time.
